newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says to hold 6-yr JGB auction on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: MOF says to hold 6-yr JGB auction on Tuesday.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) is planning to offer six-year Japanese government bonds through a price-competitive auction on Tuesday, a ministry official said on Monday.
Traders said that judging from current market conditions, the coupon rate for the new six-year issue is likely to be set at 1.9 percent, up from 1,8 percent at the previous auction.
The offer amount is expected to be cut to 400 billion yen from 500 billion yen in the previous six-year JGB auction held on May 8, they said.
Traders said if MOF continues to conduct six-year JGB auctions every other month, the ministry could raise far more than it has planned for this fiscal year.
The MOF has said it plans to raise 2.4 trillion yen by issuing six-year JGBs in the year ending next March 31, unchanged from the previous year.
